title: Cheaper flights in store? Airfare fuel surcharge to ease by Nov. 16

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) approved lower fuel surcharges for the second half of November, reflecting the decline in global jet fuel prices and giving travelers a slight reprieve. The aviation regulator, in an advisory, said that a Level 16 fuel surcharge would take effect from Nov. 16 to 30, down one notch from Level 17 during the first half of the month. Under Level 16, the additional charges airlines may collect to offset fuel price fluctuations will range from ₱525 to ₱1,535 per passenger for domestic flights and from ₱1,733.76 to ₱12,891.29 for international flights.
